why: bin/factory-weekly weighs tokens to split the week's cost between product and Factory (FACTORY_OBJECTIVE.md principle 1). Relative weights, one per kind of token, not a price: a share needs no currency, and the subscriptions bill no token (af-q55qqx.2).
source: Ratios of the providers' published list prices, 17/11/2026: a cached read costs a tenth of an input token, a cache write 1.25 input tokens, an output token 5 input tokens. Change a ratio only with its new source.
